## 0.3.0 - 2026-10-30

- Advanced current-format coaching to Regulation M-C (2026-09-09 02:00 UTC through 2026-12-02 01:59 UTC), rechecked the official source on 2026-10-30, and recorded the six named Mega Evolutions, including the Z Mega Evolutions, with their unexplained mechanics marked unverified.
- The format freshness check now warns 30 days before a current regulation window ends, and a regulation transition runbook documents the successor update.

- Dependabot auto-merge now requires every commit to come from Dependabot and revokes auto-merge when a later push leaves scope.
